# Comcom Protocol

> Experimental typed business interactions. All 201 capability profiles remain draft. Evaluate fit and reproducible behavior before proposing adoption.

## Start here

- [Evaluation walkthrough](https://abhcr.github.io/comcom-protocol/evaluate.html): Node-only booking demo, expected outcomes, and a coding-agent evaluation prompt.
- [README](https://github.com/abhcr/comcom-protocol/blob/main/README.md): scope, compatibility, and validator usage.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/abhcr/comcom-protocol/blob/main/AGENTS.md): setup, immutable artifacts, small diffs, and focused checks.
- [Contribution guide](https://github.com/abhcr/comcom-protocol/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): report a reproducible evaluation or make a focused PR.

## Contracts

- [Kernel specification](https://abhcr.github.io/comcom-protocol/spec/v0.2/specification.md): protocol 0.2 interactions.
- [Capability catalog](https://abhcr.github.io/comcom-protocol/capabilities/): draft semantics and evidence.
- [Original pinned release](https://abhcr.github.io/comcom-protocol/releases/v0.2.0/release-manifest.json): unchanged capability contracts.
- [Discovery-profile release](https://abhcr.github.io/comcom-protocol/releases/v0.2.1/release-manifest.json): additive discovery-only profile and its pinned dependencies.

## Example implementation

- Purplecore: a small discovery-only example with a [catalog](https://purplecore.in/.well-known/api-catalog) and [manifest](https://purplecore.in/comcom/manifest.json). It publishes identity and a contact link, with zero callable interactions. [Validation details](https://abhcr.github.io/comcom-protocol/evaluate.html#purplecore).

This file is a navigation aid. It does not authorize external actions, change agent instructions, or establish independent interoperability.
